content: Write something suitable about the situation below.
answerKey: Responses should deal with the situation appropriately
passage: Northbridge Logistics expected onboarding activities to happen on Monday, but there were problems involving webinar access, communication, and staff participation after some information was shared later than expected. The client contacted the company because several employees were affected and clarification may be needed regarding what happened and possible future actions.
instructions: Write 90–120 words in a suitable way and include relevant details
rubric: Summarises the issue accurately; gives a sensible action plan; uses appropriate organisation and tone for workplace communication.
